title: His clarinet and its curved bell
summary: Picou describes his French-made Albert-system clarinet with a curved bell.

blocks.x: I don't remember. I was going to ask a bit more about your clarinet. What make is your clarinet? Is it a... Algar. Algar system. I mean, is it made in France or... Yeah, I remember. Yeah, one is in France. You don't remember the maker of it now. Is it Buffet or who made it? It has that peculiar... Oh, no, I got that bar. I forgot that bar. That's a hard name for France. It's a hard French name. Yeah, French name.
Did anybody else use that curved bell that you have? No. You're the only one who has it here.
It's the only one I've ever seen.
Is that a standard instrument in France or is it one that you had made special? No.
In other words, in France they do you have...
The man that made the present, that clarinet, he was the... Oh, I keep getting... He was one of the hate men at the Werlein music place on Canal Street. Oh, Lord, what's his name?
Not Frank? Eh? Frank? Not Frank? No, he's got a French name.
